rows.candidateRo: Fiii lui Saul au fost: Ionatan, Ișvi și Malchișua. Cele două fete ale lui se numeau: cea mai mare Merab, iar cea mai mică Mical.
rows.WEBU: Now the sons of Saul were Jonathan, Ishvi, and Malchishua; and the names of his two daughters were these: the name of the firstborn Merab, and the name of the younger Michal.

rows.candidateRo: Numele nevestei lui Saul era Ahinoam, fata lui Ahimaaț. Numele căpeteniei oștirii lui era Abner, fiul lui Ner, unchiul lui Saul.
rows.WEBU: The name of Saul’s wife was Ahinoam the daughter of Ahimaaz. The name of the captain of his army was Abner the son of Ner, Saul’s uncle.

rows.candidateRo: Chis, tatăl lui Saul, și Ner, tatăl lui Abner, erau fiii lui Abiel.
rows.WEBU: Kish was the father of Saul, and Ner the father of Abner was the son of Abiel.

rows.candidateRo: „În tot timpul vieții lui Saul a fost un război înverșunat împotriva filistenilor; și de îndată ce Saul zărea vreun om tare și voinic, îl lua cu el.”
rows.WEBU: There was severe war against the Philistines all the days of Saul; and when Saul saw any mighty man or any valiant man, he took him into his service.
